_meta.codebook: openFDA human drug field reference (Human_Drug.xlsx), supplied 28 September 2026
_meta.STATUS: FILLED 28 September 2026. Fields per the openFDA field reference; MedDRA term lists built from the terms present in the data and listed per concept for clinical-lead review.

design._verified: No sampling design exists for FAERS. WT = 1, one STRATUM, each report its own PSU: every report counted once, simple binomial variance.
design.varianceMethod: None: not a probability sample. Simple binomial variance, each report counted once.

sex._note: openFDA patientsex: 0 unknown, 1 male, 2 female. The field reference lists the field without codes; this is openFDA's documented coding.

age._note: Age is not used: it is missing on many reports and recorded in mixed units.

phenotype_concepts._instruction: FAERS concepts are MedDRA preferred terms (PTs) coded on the report (patient.reaction.reactionmeddrapt), matched exactly: a list entry must equal a listed term. Lists were built from the terms present in the data and are reviewable here; terms caught by a keyword but clinically unrelated (SINUS TACHYCARDIA, SINUS ARREST, venous sinus thromboses, ANTINUCLEAR ANTIBODY) are deliberately absent. absentIsNegative: a term not coded on the report counts as not reported.

headache_migraine.questionText: Headache or migraine PTs. Procedure- and withdrawal-related headache (LUMBAR PUNCTURE HEADACHE, HEADACHE POSTOPERATIVE, DRUG WITHDRAWAL HEADACHE) excluded as secondary. SINUS HEADACHE is included: it is the masquerade label itself.

dizziness_balance.questionText: Dizziness, vertigo and vestibular PTs, matching the NAMCS R42/H81 scope (Meniere disease and vestibular neuronitis included; labyrinthitis and motion sickness excluded).

hearing_difficulty.questionText: Acquired hearing-loss PTs. Congenital terms (DEAFNESS CONGENITAL, DEAF MUTISM) excluded.

sinus_condition.questionText: Sinusitis PTs, matching the NAMCS J01/J32 scope. SINUS DISORDER, SINUS CONGESTION and SINUS PAIN excluded as non-specific.

recalcitrance_proxy._hint: Recalcitrance (repeat courses, persistence) is a patient-history construct; a single adverse-event report does not carry it.

caveats: Share of adverse-event REPORTS coding the listed MedDRA terms. FAERS is a voluntary spontaneous-reporting database with no sampling design and no count of people exposed, so this is not a prevalence among people, patients or drug users, and it cannot be compared with the survey or NAMCS rows.
Reporting is selective: it depends on the drug, publicity, reporter type and era, and a reaction coded on a report is not established as caused by the drug.
The interval is a simple binomial interval treating each report as independent. It describes counting precision within this set of reports only.

This is a sample of openFDA drug-event records (five files, reports received 2002-2012), not the full FAERS database. Fragment lines from a broken CSV flattening (1,389) were dropped; duplicate report versions were collapsed to one per safetyreportid.
No case narratives were available: the narrative column in the export holds only fragments, so the proposal 7.2 narrative-extraction benchmark could not be run on these data.
Estimates are suppressed unless at least 30 reports carry the phenotype and the RSE is 30% or less, the same thresholds used for NAMCS.
Hypothesis-generating descriptive figure, not a safety signal and not a diagnostic count.

eligibility.reason: Reports coding a sinusitis term: the proposal 3.1 'sinus headache' overlap, parallel to the NAMCS sinusitis-visit estimate. The figure is the share of those reports that also code a headache or migraine term.

phenotype_definition: Among adverse-event reports coding sinusitis, the share that also code a headache or migraine term (including SINUS HEADACHE).
